turnaround_reason: SRPT was gutted in 2025 after three patient deaths tied to its AAV gene therapies triggered an FDA distribution suspension and clinical holds; the stock fell from the high-$100s to a $14.68 low. In 2026 the safety overhang is being resolved (black-box liver-injury warning agreed, ambulant ELEVIDYS label largely intact) and the company is restructuring around a de-risked commercial base plus an siRNA pipeline.
bullish_points: ELEVIDYS still generated ~$102M net product revenue in Q1 2026 despite the safety saga, proving a durable commercial base rather than a zero

Catalyst-rich 2026: black-box warning agreed (resolves material ambulant-label risk), sNDAs filed for AMONDYS 45 and VYONDYS 53 seeking traditional approval, and early siRNA Phase 1/2 data (SRP-1001 FSHD, SRP-1003 DM1) showing dose-dependent exposure
Strategic restructuring and pipeline prioritization cutting cost, extending runway around $788M cash
Recent FDA signals read as more gene-therapy-friendly, a tailwind for both ELEVIDYS and the siRNA platform
Roche ex-US ELEVIDYS partnership provides validation and non-dilutive economics
bearish_points: Three patient deaths create a lasting safety overhang; any further ALI/ALF event could re-trigger holds or worse
Revenue down 34% YoY and gross margin negative (-17%) — the P&L is mid-restructuring and messy
Total debt $1.06B against $788M cash; not a fortress balance sheet for a company with declining revenue
Dossier technicals (SMA/RSI) came back null, so the read is fundamental/catalyst-driven not confirmed by trend
DMD gene-therapy TAM is being reassessed by payers and physicians post-deaths
catalyst: Sequential regulatory de-risking (traditional-approval conversions for AMONDYS/VYONDYS, ELEVIDYS label stabilization) plus siRNA pipeline readouts re-rating the platform
catalyst_timing: Rolling through 2H 2026 into 2027 (sNDA decisions, further siRNA data)
suggested_trade: Starter spot position (small-to-medium); consider Jan 2027 calls only for a risk-budgeted sleeve given binary safety tail
key_risk: A new liver-injury death or FDA action that re-imposes distribution/clinical holds
would_skip_if: Any fresh serious adverse-event signal, or a financing that heavily dilutes before catalysts land
